endorsements.name: Frederic Guihery
endorsements.label: Reverse and Simulate your Enemy Botnet C&C
endorsements.description: Have you ever been staring for nights at binary or hexadecimal data flows extracted from an USB channel ? Don't you remember yourself searching for some patterns and similarities in this mess of zeros and ones grabbed from a binary configuration file ? How long did it take you to find an 16bits decimal size field last time you reversed an IPC communication protocol ?
